channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: General Motors beats Wall Street's Q3 earnings expectations, narrows full-year guidance
item.description: GM narrowed its 2026 earnings guidance and raised its adjusted automotive free cash flow outlook after beating Wall Street’s third-quarter estimates.

item.title: Walmart launches joint membership with Sam's Club as it leans into delivery, gas discounts
item.description: Walmart is now offering a joint membership with Sam's Club for $120 per year as the retailer further leans into convenience.

item.title: U.S. oil surges to top $107, Brent crude at five-month high amid Mideast tensions
item.description: Oil extended its rally on Tuesday as investors continued to monitor developments in the Middle East.

item.title: Zelenskyy to meet with U.S. envoy as tensions with Trump mount
item.description: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is set to meet with U.S. special envoys on Tuesday after President Donald Trump aimed fresh criticism at the wartime leader.

item.title: Apple gets a downgrade from Loop Capital on fears of slow iPhone sales
item.description: Apple is on pace to fall short of revenue expectations tied to its iPhones, so investors should think twice before adding exposure to the tech giant, according to Loop Capital.

item.title: France curfews calm unrest as Macron faces criticism over Gulf trip
item.description: Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu said Tuesday some areas would remain under curfew after a weekend of violent rioting.

item.title: JD Vance refrains from endorsing Israeli leader Netanyahu as Trump offers praise
item.description: Vice President JD Vance declined to follow Trump in endorsing Netanyahu, saying he’s “not getting involved in Israeli elections” a week before Israelis vote.

item.title: OpenAI bugging suspect Alfozan held without bail after Saudi government offers to pay
item.description: Saudi national Abdulrahman Alfozan is accused of planting a recording device in an executive conference room at OpenAI headquarters in San Francisco.

item.title: Stock investors are ready to move on from the AI rout. Credit investors are not
item.description: Investors were still demanding high yields and more insurance on CoreWeave and Oracle bonds.

item.title: Apple announces product launch event for Oct. 28. Analysts expect touchscreen laptop
item.description: Apple sent invitations for an event next week, calling it "Pro and tell."

item.title: Alberta votes to remain part of Canada
item.description: Alberta residents voted to remain part of Canada in the province's first-ever referendum ‌on separation.

item.title: What’s making Europe so angry? The frustration behind the protests
item.description: Protests broke out in France and several European countries as people railed against living costs, poor schooling conditions, and a housing crisis.

item.title: HSBC CEO warns the AI boom won’t make every data center a good bet
item.description: Data center campuses house the servers that power AI and cloud computing.

item.title: BlackRock, GIC among investors chasing Indian telecom major Jio's IPO as anchor bids top $26 billion
item.description: Jio Platforms plans to raise up to $3.2 billion through an IPO, which is India's largest ever in rupee terms, but the second largest in dollar terms.

item.title: The world’s finance chiefs see new risks — and less China angst
item.description: Debt, AI and Ukraine dominated the conversation at the IMF-World Bank meetings in Bangkok, while China, the focus in 2018, slipped into the background.

item.title: Saudi Arabia postpones big investor conference to 2027 as Iran-backed Houthis escalate attacks on kingdom
item.description: Iran-backed Houthi militants have launched repeated volleys of missiles and drones at Saudi Arabia since a deadly airport attack earlier this month.

item.title: Anthropic is AI trade's last big hope for a major IPO this year
item.description: On Kalshi, Anthropic is seen as the last major IPO in 2026 after OpenAI delayed its public market debut. Others have postponed too.

item.title: Wells Fargo's comeback is just getting started. Here's why I'm buying
item.description: Stephanie Link sees a buying opportunity in Wells Fargo as accelerating loan growth, improving profitability and the lifting of its asset cap fuel the bank's turnaround.

item.title: Copper is outshining gold this year. Investors say the rally can survive an AI correction
item.description: Copper is up 15.8% in 2026 as investors point to AI, grid and national security demand, tight supply and tariff-driven U.S. stockpiles.

item.title: Crushed tech stocks bounce — plus, new doctor survey keeps us positive on Lilly
item.description: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

item.title: NYSE becomes latest exchange to extend options hours as appetite for around-the-clock trading grows
item.description: The New York Stock Exchange becomes second major exchange to announce extended-hours options trading for heavily traded ETFs and single stocks, following CBOE.

item.title: LightStream stops accepting loan applications. Try these 6 lenders instead
item.description: The online division of Truist Bank was "generating returns well below our targets," CFO Mike Maguire said in an earnings call.

item.title: ‘Open your doors for AI’: German chancellor urges businesses to embrace AI as Nvidia announces new investments
item.description: Nvidia announced planned investments in four German startups as Chancellor Friedrich Merz urged businesses to embrace AI at an industry summit in Berlin.

item.title: U.S. bans DeepSeek from government agency systems amid AI rift with China
item.description: U.S. Department of Homeland Security has banned DeepSeek-related technology from federal civilian agency IT systems.

item.title: Cornell sexual assault case has some prospective students rethinking plans, consultants say
item.description: Some prospective Cornell University students are rethinking applications amid the Jane Doe sexual assault lawsuit, college admissions consultants say.

item.title: Top venture capitalist Jenny Lee says Asian startups are speeding toward IPOs
item.description: The timeline for startups to do initial public offerings has accelerated, according to Granite Asia's Jenny Lee

item.title: Google says it can build data centers the right way. Some experts and residents are skeptical
item.description: Google says its Minnesota AI data center will add clean energy to the grid and protect ratepayers. Experts question whether grid upgrades are needed.

item.title: Bank Indonesia faces mounting pressure to hike after MSCI threat fuels market rout
item.description: Bank Indonesia faces growing pressure to raise rates after MSCI’s threat to cut its market to standalone status triggered a rout in stocks, weakened the rupiah.

item.title: 'Cannot play hide and seek': Minister's warning over haze sends Singapore agricultural stocks lower
item.description: Singapore Senior Minister Shanmugam said the Singapore Exchange had questioned seven firms about their operations and possible links to the haze.

item.title: U.S. Treasury yields move lower as investors await housing data
item.description: U.S. Treasury yields inched lower on Tuesday as investors awaited economic data and weighed the inflationary backdrop ahead of the rate decision next week.
